title: Implement text normalization utility
prompt:
Goal: Add a small reusable text normalization utility and prove it with focused tests. Outcome: Add a pure normalize_text helper that trims surrounding whitespace and collapses internal whitespace.
Allowed paths: src/ade/text_normalization.py
Acceptance: normalize_text is pure and deterministic; empty or whitespace-only input returns an empty string
Do not modify files outside the allowed paths.
